# Acme Corp — Employee Onboarding Handbook

Welcome to Acme Corp. This handbook covers everything a new hire needs during
the first ninety days: equipment, access, benefits, working agreements, and
who to ask when something breaks. Read it once now, and refer back to it
whenever a practical question comes up — most answers are written down here.

## IT Equipment and Accounts

New hires receive a €2,000 laptop budget. You pick your own machine from the
approved vendor catalog, and IT orders it within two business days. External
monitors, docks, and peripherals are covered by a separate €800 accessory
budget that can be used at any time during your first year. Accounts for
email, chat, and the code repository are provisioned on day one; if anything
is missing, open a ticket in the `it-helpdesk` channel rather than emailing
individual admins.

## Security and Access

Laptop disk encryption and a password manager are mandatory; IT will enable
both during your onboarding session. Two-factor authentication must use an
authenticator app, not SMS. Access to production systems is granted only
after you complete the incident-on-call shadow rotation. Never share
credentials, and rotate any password you suspect leaked immediately.

## Benefits and Time Off

Vacation accrues at 1.75 days per month, capped at 21 days carried into the
next year. Public holidays are listed in the intranet calendar. The company
covers 90% of health insurance for you and your dependents. Learning budget
is €1,500 per year — conferences, courses, and books related to your role.

## Working Agreements

Core hours are 10:00–16:00 CET; outside that window you own your schedule.
Meetings need an agenda or they can be declined without explanation. Written
async updates (the Friday digest) replace most status meetings. Decisions
live in the decision log, not in chat threads — if it is not written down,
it did not happen.

## Who To Ask

Your onboarding buddy handles day-to-day questions for the first three
months. For payroll and contracts, contact People Ops. For anything legal or
customer-data related, open a request in the `compliance-intake` form; do
not improvise answers in customer conversations.

## Before You Start Reading The Rest

This handbook is long on purpose. If you only remember three things: protect
credentials, write decisions down, and ask early — nobody expects you to
know Acme's systems in week one, only by month three.
